void DFS1(LL A, LL B) {
    if (A == 7) return;
    LL t = Cnt1 - B;

LL Cnt2, Tpow[7] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

int cmp(const void *a, const void *b) {
    LL x = *(LL*)a, y = *(LL*)b;
    if (x < y) return -1;
    if (x > y) return 1;
    return 0;
}

void DFS2(LL A, LL B) {
    if (B > n) return;
    if (check(B)) {
